meSpeak / eSpeak, distributed under the GNU General Public License.
meSpeak by Norbert Landsteiner, based on speak.js by Alon Zakai and eSpeak by Jonathan Duddington.
Bundled from npm mespeak 2.0.2 using browserify 17.0.1.
Original complete package source: source-2.0.2.tgz in this directory.
Build: browserify package/src/index.js --standalone meSpeak --outfile mespeak.js
Project source: https://github.com/sccylla/mamas-love/tree/main/video-studio

Underlying eSpeak / speak.js source and build scripts: speak-js-source.tar.gz.
Upstream: https://github.com/kripken/speak.js
